question: Should OpenClaw add a core default-off webchat-to-last-external-channel mirroring policy, or should cross-channel mirroring stay explicit through per-turn delivery or a pin/echo-style workflow?
rationale: Current main intentionally blocks webchat clients from inheriting external routes unless explicit delivery is requested, and changing that behavior affects message delivery, session state, and privacy boundaries.

options.title: Design opt-in core mirroring
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a default-off config/UI policy with explicit authorization, revocation, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Use pin or echo workflow
options.body: Treat the open pin/channel echo direction as the preferred consent model and close or narrow this issue after that direction is confirmed.

options.title: Decline core mirroring
options.body: Document explicit delivery as the supported path and leave the old incidental cross-channel workflow unsupported.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in core mirroring
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a default-off config/UI policy with explicit authorization, revocation, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Gateway chat, webchat, and session routing decisions.
